opening.argument: The title identifies the activity as “CALLING TECH SUPPORT SCAMMERS LIVE | popups,” establishing that the subject is purported scammers and their popups, not an offer made by the creator. The displayed material shows the encryption alert, SUPPORT and PAY controls, a connected GoToAssist support session, and file-transfer and payment discussion. These interfaces are presented as material being examined in the course of calling and documenting suspected tech-support scammers. Nothing shown indicates that the creator solicits payment, credentials, or remote access from viewers. Taken together, the evidence supports an anti-scam investigation or test focused on exposing purported scam conduct, rather than presenting that conduct as the video's own acquisition pathway.
